headline: Nigeria Approves Super Grids to Raise Transmission Capacity to 19,000 MW
summary: The Nigerian federal government approved procurement for East and West Super Grids to raise national electricity transmission capacity from 5,000 megawatts to 19,000 MW within two years.
why: Infrastructure enhancements in power transmission are critical to resolving energy bottlenecks that constrain industrial productivity and economic growth in Nigeria.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: Upgrading transmission capacity directly supports higher power distribution and industrial reliability.
